id: \bThank you for stopping those thieves. If you hadn't shown up I don't know what we would have done.
en: \bThank you for stopping those thieves. If you hadn't shown up I don't know what we would have done.
it: \bGrazie per aver fermato quei ladri. Se non fossi arrivato tu, non so cosa avremmo fatto.

id: \bHow about this? if you beat me in a battle, I'll give you a TM as thanks.
en: \bHow about this? if you beat me in a battle, I'll give you a TM as thanks.
it: \bChe ne dici di questo? Se mi batti in una lotta, ti darò una MT per ringraziarti.

id: \bYou have a lot of potential. As I promised, here is your TM.
en: \bYou have a lot of potential. As I promised, here is your TM.
it: \bHai un grande potenziale. Come promesso, ecco la tua MT.

id: \bTM70 contains Flash. Use it to blind your foe.
en: \bTM70 contains Flash. Use it to blind your foe.
it: \bLa MT70 contiene Flash. Usala per accecare l'avversario.

id: \bOnly those who have trained rigorously are allowed to go up.
en: \bOnly those who have trained rigorously are allowed to go up.
it: \bSolo chi si è allenato duramente può salire.

id: \rJessie: You walked right into our trap.
en: \rJessie: You walked right into our trap.
it: \rJessie: Sei caduto dritto nella nostra trappola.

id: \bMeowth: Now that you're here we will be taking your Pokémon.
en: \bMeowth: Now that you're here we will be taking your Pokémon.
it: \bMeowth: Ora che sei qui, ci prenderemo i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bJames: Don't even try and resist us.
en: \bJames: Don't even try and resist us.
